title: Crux Response Contract v1 (CRC-v1)
description: The unified, pointer-first, progressively-hydrated response envelope shared across CoreCrux /v1/query/*, VaultCrux /v1/memory/retrieve, and the Crux daemon HTTP + MCP surface. A response is CRC-v1 ONLY when the caller negotiated it (Accept-Contract: crc-v1 / contract:"v1" / ?contract=v1); otherwise endpoints return their legacy shape byte-identically. This schema is the single conformance oracle: every emitting endpoint must serialize through it, and it is the same document served by get_bootstrap(topic="tool-output").

kind.description: Routing class. search = fuzzy ranked retrieval; addressed = exact key resolve routed AROUND the ranker; fact = fact-store resolve; session = session-state resolve.

hydrate_tier.description: Echo of the requested/served hydration. CRC-v1 DEFAULT is 'pointer'.

pointers.description: Cheap addressable handles. Present for kind=search|addressed at every tier (a pointer is always returnable). epitome is capped (~40 tok at pointer tier).

id.description: Opaque handle usable verbatim in the expand/fetch-content call (e.g. "<segment_index>:<doc_id>" or a fact_id/slug).

content.description: Hydrated bodies. MUST be absent or empty when hydrate_tier=pointer; populated at summary|full. Each item carries the same id as its pointer so callers can join.

cost_estimate.description: Token cost to hydrate the current result set at each tier. Lets a caller decide whether to expand. Required for retrieval kinds (search/addressed); optional for fact/session.

agent_decision.description: Retrieval-routing transparency + next-step guidance. Promoted from CoreCrux AgentDecisionV1. Present (non-null) for kind=search; null otherwise.

envelope.description: Audit + freshness metadata. Extended from the daemon's 4-tool audit envelope to ALL reads. freshness is present for kind=addressed|fact (where supersession/decay applies).

next.description: Self-correction affordances. expand tells the caller exactly how to hydrate the pointers it wants; resolution_pointer points at a __bootstrap__::resolution:* playbook on low-coverage/empty/timeout.

expand.description: Endpoint + how to selectively hydrate (e.g. "POST /v1/query/fetch-content {refs:[id...], hydrate:full}").

canonical_slug.description: For addressed/session kinds: echo the canonical key so the next turn re-addresses by slot, not re-search.

meta.description: Per-endpoint diagnostics (backend, took_ms, score_space, lane diagnostics, bandit_variant, etc.). Free-form; never load-bearing for the contract.

then.description: At pointer tier, no hydrated bodies may be returned (the whole point of the cheap default).
